title: Remove reader-side export backfills from leaderboard generation
description:
`puppeteer/src/puppeteer/leaderboard.py` still normalizes historical export gaps at read time instead of consuming a single migrated schema. Today it:
- Recomputes `toolCallsOk` and `toolCallsFailed` from `llmEvents` in `_backfill_player_stats()`.
- Recomputes `thinkingTimeSecs` from adjacent `llmEvents` timestamps when player summaries omit it.
- Falls back to deriving Commander from `gameType` when `deckType` is missing in `derive_format()`.

That is the same backwards-compatibility pattern removed from `website/src/utils/load-games.ts`, just on the Python side. The leaderboard should read one export shape, fail fast when required fields are missing, and rely on schema migrations to normalize old exports instead of keeping reader-side shims.
